subject: Scope & SOW: annual penetration testing — retainer tiers and evidence retention
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@ellissec.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Ellis Security - annual testing SOW and retainer options

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking a look with us last week. Attached is our initial SOW (Ellis_Security_SOW_v1.pdf) and a short pricing matrix. High-level summary: we offer three retainer tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold) — Silver is our most common for growth-stage SaaS (2 targeted appsec engagements + 1 tabletop / advisory touch per year).

Key clauses I want to surface up front:
- Evidence & artifacts retention: default 18 months unless customer requests shorter retention.
- Deliverables: executive report + technical appendix + raw findings archive (encrypted at rest).
- SLA: standard 5 business day delivery for the executive report after validation call; remediation verification windows are quoted separately.

We can scope the Silver package to include a full-stack web app test + CI pipeline review for the quoted price of $45k/yr. If you prefer a bespoke scope (incl. red team), pricing moves accordingly — see section 4 of the SOW.

If you can share your preferred retention window and any legal/compliance requirements (e.g., KMS/HSM or data residency), I’ll feed that to legal and pricing for an updated draft.

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call next week to go over changes.

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of Client Partnerships
Ellis Security
ellen@ellissec.com

Attachment: Ellis_Security_SOW_v1.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Ellis Security - annual testing SOW and retainer options

Marissa / Neha — forwarding Ellis' SOW and pricing. Quick asks from my side:

- Evidence retention: Ellis default is 18 months. Security prefers 12 months maximum for external vendor artifacts unless we have a clear business need. Can you confirm whether 12 months is acceptable or if we need to push to 6/12/18?
- KMS/CMK: we want customer-managed keys if they retain raw archives. Do we have a standard clause we must apply?
- SLA exceptions: they quote 5 business days for exec report. For live production tests we likely need a faster remediation verification window or a canary process.
- Pricing: target is to keep this sub-$50k for Silver, but I'm open to approving Gold only if the deliverables justify it.

I've attached my redline notes (redline_notes_rachel.pdf) with a couple of non-legal redlines (scope boundaries, blackout windows, preliminary dates). Please reply with the redlines you want me to send back to Ellen so we can consolidate.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Manager, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline_notes_rachel.pdf

Thanks Rachel — quick procurement/contract points from my side:

- Termination & notice: we need a 30-day termination for convenience, 60-day for any multi-year commitment; add explicit refund terms for prepaid retainers.
- Liability cap: propose limiting to the greater of $1M or 3x fees. Please confirm preferred language.
- PO & billing: Ellis needs to accept standard Redwood PO process; confirm they can invoice quarterly.
- Evidence retention: agree with aiming for 12 months. If Ellis insists on 18, request a specific justification (regulatory or evidence replay requirement) and limit the retained artifact types.
- Data handling: require vendor to store raw artifacts in our customer-designated bucket (or S3 path) encrypted with CMK; vendor access via temporary creds only.

If we land on Silver with 2 assessments/year, I can approve up to $50k with the above protections. Anything above that will need finance sign-off and a short memo.

Marissa
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:51:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Ellis Security - annual testing SOW and retainer options

Couple of technical items to add to procurement redlines:

- Evidence & logs: we must not allow long-lived vendor-hosted storage of raw logs. If Ellis requires archive access for replay, it must be to a copy we host (customer-managed S3) for up to 12 months. Any retained artifacts must be encrypted with customer-managed keys (KMS CMK) and keys rotated per Redwood policy.
- HSM: for signing of proofs and post-engagement attestations, request HSM-backed key signing or equivalent attestation mechanism.
- Scope clarity: ensure network-layer vs application-layer delineation. If red team includes phishing/social engineering, require separate approval from HR and legal.
- Test windows: we need blackout windows for high-risk production traffic/events (please propose 3 backup weeks).
- Evidence destruction: include clause requiring secure deletion verification after retention window (delete logs, destroy copies and provide signed attestation).

If Ellis can accept these items, 12 months retention + CMK + secure deletion attestation should be acceptable to security. Otherwise, we need a written justification for any longer retention.

Neha Kapoor
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ellis Security - annual testing SOW and retainer options (requested updates)

Hi Ellen — thanks for the quick turnaround last week. Internal feedback consolidated below (procurement & security):

1) Retainer tiering and pricing
- We are tentatively aligned on the Silver retainer (2 assessments + advisory). Price target: up to $50k/yr. Please update the SOW to reflect Silver specifics and a revised quote if any items below change pricing.

2) Evidence retention & key management (security must-haves)
- Change default retention to a maximum of 12 months for raw findings and logs.
- If Ellis requires longer retention for specific replay/testing reasons, provide a documented justification and send a request to security@redwood.ai for approval.
- All raw archives MUST be stored in a customer-designated S3 location, encrypted with customer-managed keys (AWS KMS CMK). Vendor access should be temporary IAM creds restricted to the path.
- Include a secure deletion clause: vendor must securely delete any copies after retention window and provide signed attestation within 10 business days.

3) Legal & procurement items
- Add 30-day termination for convenience and standard liability cap language (Marissa will provide exact wording).
- Vendor must accept our PO/billing cadence (quarterly invoices supported).

4) Operations & scheduling
- Proposed kickoff window: week of 6 Dec 2026. Please propose three candidate test weeks and blackout windows; we will choose one.

5) Deliverables & SLAs
- Executive report: 3 business days after final validation call. Technical appendix and raw archived findings: delivered in customer bucket within 5 business days.
- Please include remediation verification options (48-hour verification window preferred for critical findings) as an add-on line item.

Can you return an updated SOW with the redlines above and a DocuSign-ready signature page? If possible, include a revised quote for the Silver package and the price delta to include a single red team augmentation.

I've attached our internal redline for reference. Once we have the updated SOW, I will route to Finance for sign-off if the final quote stays <= $50k.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Manager, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline_notes_rachel.pdf
